description: Final integration, infrastructure, and polish: Docker Compose for local PostgreSQL, ESLint + Prettier config for both packages, the root-level implementation plan markdown file, and any cross-package seam fixes identified during FEAT-001–003 integration. Independent of the other FEATs in that it adds wrapping infrastructure, but should run last to catch integration issues.
steps: 1. Create docker-compose.yml at the workspace root /Users/shrezzzzz/Documents/Code/Routesy/docker-compose.yml with the exact contents from the spec: postgres:16-alpine, POSTGRES_USER=routeora, POSTGRES_PASSWORD=routeora, POSTGRES_DB=routeora, port 5432:5432, named volume postgres_data. Add a comment at the top: '# Run: docker compose up -d to start local PostgreSQL for development'.

2. Create packages/backend/.eslintrc.json: extends @typescript-eslint/recommended, parser @typescript-eslint/parser, parserOptions project ./tsconfig.json, rules: no-console warn (allow in index.ts), @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars error, @typescript-eslint/explicit-function-return-type off (too verbose for Express handlers).
3. Create packages/backend/.prettierrc: singleQuote true, semi true, tabWidth 2, trailingComma es5, printWidth 100.

4. Create packages/frontend/.eslintrc.json: extends @typescript-eslint/recommended, plugin:react-hooks/recommended, plugin:react/recommended, parserOptions project ./tsconfig.json, settings react.version detect, rules: react/react-in-jsx-scope off (React 18 automatic JSX transform).
5. Create packages/frontend/.prettierrc: same as backend — singleQuote true, semi true, tabWidth 2, trailingComma es5, printWidth 100.

6. Add lint dev dependencies to both packages: @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin@7.1.1, @typescript-eslint/parser@7.1.1, eslint@8.57.0, prettier@3.2.5. Frontend also needs eslint-plugin-react@7.33.2, eslint-plugin-react-hooks@4.6.0. Install via npm install --save-dev in each package.
7. Verify the root package.json 'lint' script correctly delegates to both packages (already set up by setup step). Run 'npm run lint' from root and fix any auto-fixable lint errors in generated code.

8. Run 'npm run build' from the workspace root to verify both packages compile cleanly as a monorepo. Fix any TypeScript errors surfaced by the full build that were not caught by per-package builds (e.g., type mismatches across the api.ts contract).
9. Run 'npm test' from the workspace root to verify all vitest tests in both packages pass together.

10. Write /Users/shrezzzzz/Documents/Code/Routesy/README.md: project title, short description, tech stack list, setup instructions (clone, npm install, copy .env.example to .env, docker compose up -d, cd packages/backend && npx prisma migrate dev, npm run dev from root), available npm scripts, API base URL note, link to share URL pattern.

11. Write /Users/shrezzzzz/Documents/Code/Routesy/.agents/tasks/plan.md: the canonical implementation plan document (see plan.md content below — this is what the workflow's original loop would have run from). It summarizes all four FEATs as an ordered numbered checklist.

12. Make a final commit on the current branch with message 'feat: complete Routeora full-stack implementation'. Stage all modified and new files: docker-compose.yml, README.md, packages/backend/**, packages/frontend/**. Never push — the git-push step handles that.
acceptance_criteria: docker-compose.yml exists at workspace root and contains postgres:16-alpine service
npm run build from workspace root exits 0 (both packages build)
npm test from workspace root exits 0 (all tests pass)
A git commit exists on the branch with all files staged
findings: Installed @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin@7.1.1, @typescript-eslint/parser@7.1.1, eslint@8.57.0, prettier@3.2.5 in backend; same plus eslint-plugin-react@7.33.2, eslint-plugin-react-hooks@4.6.0 in frontend. Fixed 16 backend ESLint errors by tuning .eslintrc.json rules (varsIgnorePattern for _-prefixed destructured vars, no-namespace off for Express augmentation, no-var-requires off for nanoid CommonJS import). Fixed 2 frontend ESLint errors: removed unused forwardRef/ref from MapContainer.tsx (converted to plain function component), removed unused refetchStops destructure in TripPlanner.tsx. npm run lint, npm run build, and npm test all pass cleanly.
